Peat is produced by composting [[crop waste]].  It can be used to fertilize crop spaces such as [[empty garden bed]]s, [[Garden bed with sticks|garden beds with sticks]], and [[vine trellis]]es.  {{PAGENAME}} acts as a {{Quality|copper}}boost and {{Quality|copper}}quality fertilizer.  Crops grown with {{PAGENAME}} will have their growth time reduced by 20% and will yield +1 seed and +1 product when harvested.  For more information about the effects and use of fertilizer see [[farming]].

Peat is available for purchase from the [[Shepherd]].
